description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/latlon3d/rules/varcoeff_laplacian_lev_robin_surface_bc (variable-coefficient vertical diffusion with a resistance-in-series ROBIN SURFACE-EXCHANGE ground -- dry deposition out, prescribed emission in -- and a zero-flux model top) driven by problems/latlon3d_diffusion_vertical_robin_surface.esm. Refines NLEV alone (16 -> 128), lon and lat passive. Manufactured solution u(z,t) = phi(z) + exp(-pi^2 t) psi(z), a transient decaying onto the emission/deposition steady state, with vdep = 0.3 and emis = vdep + pi/8 (the value that makes phi satisfy the continuous Robin condition). SECOND ORDER in both L2 and Linf (observed 2.00 / 1.99) -- the SAME order as the no-flux sibling latlon3d_diffusion_vertical_noflux, which is the point of this case: the surface exchange costs nothing in accuracy PROVIDED it is closed by resistance in series. THIS CASE IS THE REGRESSION GUARD FOR THAT: the obvious alternative closure -- applying the deposition velocity directly to the first-cell value -- is inconsistent (an O(1) truncation error), and it is invisible at coarse resolution, holding an apparent order 1.98 at NLEV = 32 before unravelling to 1.52 at 64 and 1.16 at 128. A four-point ladder reaching NLEV = 128 is what makes the difference detectable; do not shorten it.
